lines.zh: 盾牌顶在肩前，我踏着队列前行。
lines.en: Shield braced at my shoulder, I keep the marching line.

lines.zh: 短剑贴身，脚步声要踩得齐。
lines.en: Gladius close at my hip, our footfalls must match.

lines.zh: 罗马的方阵走起来从不散开。
lines.en: A Roman square never loosens as it walks.

lines.zh: 一步一盾，路面被我们踩实。
lines.en: One step, one shield; we pack the road hard.

lines.zh: 我绕过营门，铁靴敲着石阶。
lines.en: I round the camp gate, iron boots ringing on stone.

lines.zh: 队伍向前，我把目光留在两侧。
lines.en: The column advances; I keep my eyes on the flanks.

lines.zh: 剑柄轻碰盾沿，那是前进的节拍。
lines.en: My hilt taps the shield rim, the beat of our advance.

lines.zh: 我们踏过草径，行列依旧笔直。
lines.en: We cross the grass path and the ranks stay straight.

lines.zh: 我走在第六排，前面全是盾。
lines.en: I march in the sixth rank, nothing ahead but shields.

lines.zh: 军旗在前，我跟着旗影走。
lines.en: The standard leads; I walk inside its shadow.

lines.zh: 脚下是沙土，队列扬起了尘。
lines.en: Sand underfoot, the column kicks up dust.

lines.zh: 盾举高些，替身后的同袍遮着。
lines.en: Shield raised a little, shading the men behind me.

lines.zh: 站久了，盾沿压得手臂发酸。
lines.en: Standing this long, the shield rim numbs my arm.

lines.zh: 我数着营中的火堆，一共七处。
lines.en: I count the campfires: seven in all.

lines.zh: 短剑入鞘，我仍守着这面墙。
lines.en: Sword sheathed, I still guard this wall.

lines.zh: 风吹过盔缨，我一动不动。
lines.en: Wind stirs my helmet crest; I do not move.

lines.zh: 队列暂歇，我的脚跟没有挪。
lines.en: The ranks rest, but my heels stay planted.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处的路口，等换岗。
lines.en: I watch the far crossing, waiting for relief.

lines.zh: 铁甲里闷得厉害，队形不能松。
lines.en: The mail is stifling, yet the formation holds.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔干裂的嘴唇，继续站着。
lines.en: I lick my cracked lips and keep standing.

lines.zh: 这一班还没结束，我不坐。
lines.en: My watch is not over; I do not sit.

lines.zh: 盾面上的划痕，我认得每一道。
lines.en: I know every scratch on this shield face.
Halt and name where you come from.

lines.zh: 你不是本营的人，走近些。
lines.en: You are not of this camp. Come closer.

lines.zh: 我的盾对着你，先说明身份。
lines.en: My shield faces you; state who you are.

lines.zh: 罗马的营地不接待陌生人。
lines.en: A Roman camp takes in no strangers.

lines.zh: 你腰间那把剑，让我看看。
lines.en: That blade at your belt, let me see it.

lines.zh: 我在看你的手，不是你的脸。
lines.en: I watch your hands, not your face.

lines.zh: 若是商队，就走中间那条道。
lines.en: If you are a caravan, take the middle road.
Do not slide your hand under your cloak.
There is foreign mud on your boots.

lines.zh: 我记住你的样子了，路人。
lines.en: I have your look now, traveler.
Speak your business; I am still on duty.
Take half a step back and I lower the shield.

lines.zh: 这一下打穿了我的护肩。
lines.en: That blow punched through my shoulder guard.
I grit my teeth as blood seeps under my helm.
It hurts, but the formation must not break.
A dent has been hammered into my shield.
I suck in a breath and step back into place.
Whoever cut me, I have seen you clearly.
My knee buckles, then I hold.
A scale cracked; I heard it go.
This wound goes into the muster roll.
I give half a step, then push back in.

lines.zh: 哪来的麦香，我的胃先动了。
lines.en: Where is that bread smell? My stomach moved first.

lines.zh: 我咽了口唾沫，队列不能乱。
lines.en: I swallow hard; the ranks must not break.
That smell urges me more than any order.

lines.zh: 甜香飘进盔里，我偏了头。
lines.en: Sweet smoke slips under my helm and turns my head.

lines.zh: 我只闻一闻，手还按在盾上。
lines.en: I only breathe it in; my hand stays on the shield.

lines.zh: 谁在那边烤东西，站出来。
lines.en: Whoever is roasting over there, step forward.

lines.zh: 香气绕过盾沿，钻进我的鼻子。
lines.en: The smell curls past my shield rim into my nose.

lines.zh: 我的肚子叫了一声，真丢人。
lines.en: My belly growled. How shameful.

lines.zh: 换岗之后，我要找那口锅。
lines.en: After relief, I am finding that pot.
Do not wave food in front of me.
You hit my shield. Back away.
You are standing on my place in the line.
Steady yourself; do not skew the square.
Iron on iron makes a fine loud noise.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开半步，你过吧。
lines.en: I turn half a step aside. Pass.
Stop pushing; there is another rank behind me.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲被你顶得生疼。
lines.en: Your knock left my pauldron aching.
Keep your spacing. That is the rule.
You knocked my shield off its angle.
Too close. Shift to the left.

lines.zh: 等这场仗打完，我回去找她。
lines.en: When this campaign ends, I go back to her.

lines.zh: 营火边，我和她分一块面包。
lines.en: By the fire she and I split one loaf.

lines.zh: 我把盔缨上的红绳给了她。
lines.en: I gave her the red cord from my crest.

lines.zh: 只有夜里，方阵才允许成双。
lines.en: Only at night may the square hold pairs.
Her hand is warmer than my sword grip.

lines.zh: 我们约在橄榄树下，没人看见。
lines.en: We meet under the olive tree, unseen.

lines.zh: 军规管不住这半刻的安静。
lines.en: Regulations cannot govern this half hour of quiet.
She wipes the mud from my shield.
I promised I would come back alive.

lines.zh: 两副铁甲并排放着，就这样。
lines.en: Two sets of armor set side by side. That is all.
This iron nail goes into my belt pouch.
A broken sword on the ground; it can be ground down.
I pick up the bread crumbs. Nothing is wasted.
This stone fits my sling nicely.
Whose coin is this? It goes to the unit.
I gather the torn cloth of our standard.

lines.zh: 一枚箭头，我把弯的掰直。
lines.en: An arrowhead; I bend the curve straight.
There is still salt in this little bag.

lines.zh: 我把水囊重新挂回腰间。
lines.en: I hang the waterskin back at my hip.
Everything found gets logged. No squabbling.
Someone over there has drawn a blade.
My eyes have locked onto him.
An enemy slips out from behind the tree.
He is coming at us. Shields up.
I see his knife moving.
Movement on the left of the line.
That one. Keep him off the standard.

lines.zh: 我的短剑已经出鞘一半。
lines.en: My gladius is already half drawn.
That man wears the enemy camp's armor.
I have his footwork now.

lines.zh: 号角没响，但我已找到他。
lines.en: No horn sounded, but I found him.
He is panting; I see his white breath.

lines.zh: 目标清楚了，那个持矛的。
lines.en: Target clear: the one with the spear.
I lower my shield and wait for range.
He circles left; I turn with him.
I am counting his steps.
He still hesitates. I wait.
Shield rim on him, not one inch given.

lines.zh: 他的脚踩断了一根树枝。
lines.en: His foot snapped a branch.
I close the formation half a block.
He will not move first, so I will.

lines.zh: 他往前挪，我的盾跟着压。
lines.en: He edges forward, and my shield presses with him.
That shape sways in the grass.
Five paces out. Hold steady.

lines.zh: 我盯着他握刀的那只手。
lines.en: I watch the hand holding his knife.

lines.zh: 他退我也进，队列不许散。
lines.en: He retreats, I advance; the line stays whole.
He is breathing harder than I am.
My point rests on his chest.

lines.zh: 他背后的同伙我看得见。
lines.en: I can see the comrade behind him.
Now I wait for him to raise that arm.

lines.zh: 脚步声近了，我再等半拍。
lines.en: Footsteps near. I wait one more beat.
My gladius stabs under his ribs.
The shield rim cracks across his face.
I press a step in and the blade follows.
This one comes stabbing out from behind the shield.
He blocked high; his low guard is empty.
Iron knocks his wooden shield aside.
I shove with the shield, then add a thrust.
My point grazes his leather jerkin.
He stumbles back half a step; I follow.
I stab for his throat and miss.
Shield guards my chest, blade goes wide.

lines.zh: 这一剑带着整队的力气。
lines.en: This thrust carries the whole rank's weight.
My shove puts his back against the wall.
My hilt cracks him under the chin.
Two quick thrusts, both kept short.
He lifts his arm; my blade arrives first.
Blood spatters across my shield face.
I draw my blade back. He falls.
The camp gate opens and I walk into the dust.
The standard's shadow falls on my shoulder. I stand.

lines.zh: 我从罗马的营道里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of the Roman camp road.
A fresh rank, shields brought level.
No horn yet, and I am already in place.

lines.zh: 我从石柱间穿过，铁靴作响。
lines.en: I pass between the columns, iron boots loud.
This camp is ours to hold now.
The officer calls the roll; I answer.

lines.zh: 我带着短剑，走进日光里。
lines.en: Gladius at my side, I walk into the daylight.
Tents behind me, the road ahead.
The unit forms up; I take the left wing.

lines.zh: 尘土还没落，我已经站稳。
lines.en: The dust has not settled, and I am already planted.

lines.zh: 火苗舔过盔甲，烫得我后退。
lines.en: Flames lick my armor and drive me back.

lines.zh: 我从石阶上摔下，盾先着地。
lines.en: I fall down the steps, shield hitting first.

lines.zh: 水灌进盔里，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Water floods my helmet and I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 那声爆响掀翻了我的盾。
lines.en: The blast tore my shield away.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的肩甲缝。
lines.en: An arrow buried itself in my pauldron seam.

lines.zh: 那股光压下来，我骨头都凉。
lines.en: That light pressed down and chilled my bones.
Three days unfed and my sword wavers.

lines.zh: 雷打上铁甲，我麻了半边。
lines.en: Lightning struck my iron and numbed half of me.

lines.zh: 我坠进黑色里，什么也抓不住。
lines.en: I fall into the black and catch at nothing.
